shots.name: Plunger / Shooter Lane
shots.notes: Manual pull. Light plunge lands on the upper-right flipper (lights Bank Shot Skill Shot); hard plunge reaches the top rollover lanes or scores a lit Right Super Cue.

shots.name: Left Orbit
shots.notes: Runs up the far-left edge to the top rollover lanes. Doubles as the Left Super Cue shot when lit (via flashing Orange standup hit).

shots.name: Right Orbit
shots.notes: Runs up the far-right edge; also reachable backhand off the upper-right flipper. Doubles as the Right Super Cue shot when lit (via flashing Purple standup hit).

shots.name: Captive Ball ("The Moose")
shots.notes: Two-ball captive system. Weak hit = internal rollover (3K); strong hit = internal target (30K+3K) and progresses toward an Extra Ball (default 4 hits).

shots.name: Green Drop Targets
shots.notes: 3 white drop targets, upper-left playfield. Clearing all 3 lights the Green standup.

shots.name: Green Standup
shots.notes: Behind the Green drop bank; flashing-lit once all 3 drops are down, sinks ball 6/14.

shots.name: Brown Drop Targets
shots.notes: 3 white drop targets under the "Pool Hall" plastic, upper-right playfield, below the Bank Shot lane.

shots.name: Brown Standup
shots.notes: Behind the Brown drop bank; flashing-lit once all 3 drops are down, sinks ball 7/15.

shots.name: Purple Standup
shots.notes: Left edge of the Center Pockets entrance. Sinks ball 4/12 when lit; when flashing, hitting it lights the Right Super Cue.

shots.name: Orange Standup
shots.notes: Right edge of the Center Pockets entrance. Sinks ball 5/13 when lit; when flashing, hitting it lights the Left Super Cue.

shots.name: Yellow Rollover Lane
shots.notes: Sinks ball 1/9. Also advances the end-of-ball bonus multiplier.

shots.name: Blue Rollover Lane
shots.notes: Sinks ball 2/10. Also advances the end-of-ball bonus multiplier.

shots.name: Red Rollover Lane
shots.notes: Sinks ball 3/11. Also advances the end-of-ball bonus multiplier.

shots.name: Jet Bumpers
shots.notes: 3 pop bumpers in an inverted-triangle arrangement, dead center, above the Center Pockets and below the rollover lanes.

shots.name: Bank Shot Lane
shots.notes: Small secondary orbit/lane, upper-right corner, almost only reachable from the upper-right flipper. Scores the Skill Shot and the headline catch-and-relaunch farm loop.

shots.name: Upper-Right Flipper
shots.notes: 3rd flipper, notable for being able to trap/catch cleanly (unusual for a mini flipper). Services Bank Shot lane, Brown targets, backhand Right Orbit, and jet bumpers.

shots.name: 8-Ball Saucer
shots.notes: Multi-purpose kickout: sinks the 8-ball, starts/re-jackpots Ball-O-Rama, and hosts Call Your Shot and Collect Bonus. Unlit = 10K.

shots.name: Center Pockets — Center Saucer
shots.notes: The main toy's center saucer. Capturing a 3rd ball here starts Breakshot Frenzy; hosts the Frenzy jackpot, Cutthroat Countdown's Super Jackpot, and the Nine Ball Bonus entrance opto.

shots.name: Center Pockets — Left Saucer
shots.notes: Side lock saucer. Locking a ball here (when lit) counts toward Ball-O-Rama/Breakshot Frenzy.

shots.name: Center Pockets — Right Saucer
shots.notes: Side lock saucer, mirror of the left. Locking here plus the left saucer sets up Breakshot Frenzy.

shots.name: Center Pockets — Rising Post
shots.notes: Rises when a ball trips the entrance opto; a hard hit propels resting ball(s) into the side saucers. Both saucers made on one hit = Nice Combo/"Breakshot" (250K).

shots.name: Left Inlane
shots.notes: Inside the left slingshot. Briefly lights Call Your Shot at the 8-Ball Saucer.

shots.name: Right Inlane
shots.notes: Inside the right slingshot. Scores a flat 3K.

shots.name: Left Outlane
shots.notes: Has a kickback "Kicker" coil, lit by knocking down either drop-target bank in sequential order.

shots.name: Right Outlane
shots.notes: No kickback.

shots.name: Left Slingshot
shots.notes: Standard scoring slingshot above/outside the left flipper.

shots.name: Right Slingshot
shots.notes: Standard scoring slingshot above/outside the right flipper.

shots.name: Left Flipper
shots.notes: Main flipper, standard bottom-left position.

shots.name: Right Flipper
shots.notes: Main flipper, standard bottom-right position.

shots.name: Center Post
shots.notes: Rubber-lined stationary post between the two main flippers; not to be confused with the Center Pockets' rising post.

shots.name: Drain
shots.notes: Outhole, dead center below the center post.

goals.title: Skill Shot — Light Plunge to the Bank Shot
goals.summary: A soft plunge parks the ball on the upper-right flipper, lighting the Bank Shot; catch and cash it for a guaranteed 100K and a sunk ball with almost no drain risk.
goals.reward: 100K + sinks the next ball in the active pool game

steps.detail: Bring the ball down to the flippers — the skill shot is made with a flipper.

steps.action: Plunge through, then catch it clean, then shoot the lit Bank Shot
steps.detail: Just enough power to drop the ball onto the upper-right flipper instead of reaching the top lanes — this lights the Bank Shot (flashing green light). Trap the ball on the 3rd flipper before attempting anything else, then fire it into the Bank Shot lane — 100,000 points and a sunk ball in whichever pool game is active.

goals.title: Alternate Skill Shot — Hard Plunge to the Lanes
goals.summary: A full-power plunge skips the Bank Shot line entirely and sends the ball to the top rollover lanes (or scores a Right Super Cue if already lit) — lower value but useful for building rollover progress.
goals.reward: Advances the bonus multiplier + sinks a numbered ball; scores a lit Right Super Cue instead if already lit

steps.action: Plunge at full strength into the rollover lanes
steps.detail: Ball flies past the upper-right flipper up to the top lanes — no Skill Shot bonus, but you keep control of shot choice and it advances the bonus multiplier and sinks the lowest unsunk numbered ball for that lane.

goals.title: Capcombo — Bank Shot into Right Orbit
goals.summary: The game's signature flow combo: land the Bank Shot, then immediately loop into the Right Orbit before anything else, for a flat 250K and the moose-kicks-a-cow animation.
goals.reward: 250K + the moose-kicks-a-cow animation (Capcombo)

steps.detail: Doesn't need to be lit for the combo to count.
Must be the very next shot — anything intervening breaks it.

goals.title: Capcombo — Left Super Cue into Right Orbit
goals.summary: Second way to trigger Capcombo: shoot the Left Super Cue (Left Orbit lit via a flashing Orange hit) then immediately follow with the Right Orbit for 250K.
goals.reward: 250K (Capcombo)

steps.action: Hit the Orange standup while flashing
steps.detail: Lights the Left Super Cue at the Left Orbit.

steps.action: Shoot the lit Left Super Cue
steps.detail: Right Orbit doesn't need to be lit for the combo.
Completes Capcombo for 250K — must follow with no other shot in between.

goals.title: Nice Combo ("Breakshot") — Both Center Saucers on One Post Hit
goals.summary: With two balls resting against the raised center post, a hard hit that propels both into the left and right side saucers on the same shot scores the game's namesake 250K combo.
goals.reward: 250K + both sunk-ball awards (Nice Combo/"Breakshot")

steps.action: Get two balls resting against the raised post
steps.detail: Feed the Center Pockets entrance until the post is up with balls captured against it.

steps.action: Drive both balls into the side saucers
steps.detail: One hard hit on the post should send both balls flying — one needs to land here.

steps.action: ...and the other lands here in the same motion
steps.detail: Both side saucers made on one post hit = Nice Combo/"Breakshot": +250K plus both sunk-ball awards.

goals.title: Bank Shot Catch-and-Relaunch Loop
goals.summary: The single highest-value repeatable sequence in the game: keep re-shooting and re-catching the Bank Shot from the upper-right flipper without ever letting the ball leave the top-right corner. Value escalates fast — 1M+ per lap is reachable by the 8th-10th rep.
goals.reward: 100K + sunk ball on first make, escalating each consecutive catch (100K, 200K, 300K...; 1M+ by lap 8-10 reported)

steps.detail: Drops the ball onto the upper-right flipper and lights the Bank Shot.
Trap cleanly — this is the only shot in the loop, repeated.
First make = 100K + sunk ball; each consecutive make while still flashing multiplies the value (100K, 200K, 300K...).
Re-catch on the same flipper before the flashing green light times out, then shoot again. Keep looping while the catch feels clean; a missed catch resets the value to base.

goals.title: Both Super Cues Back-to-Back
goals.summary: Light and hit the Right Super Cue then the Left Super Cue (or vice versa) without a miss in between to light the Captive Ball for an Extra Ball — arguably the highest-leverage combo in the game since it buys more time for the Bank Shot loop.
goals.reward: Lights the Captive Ball for an Extra Ball

steps.action: Hit the Purple standup while flashing
steps.detail: Lights the Right Super Cue at the Right Orbit.

steps.action: Hit the Orange standup while flashing
steps.detail: Lights the Left Super Cue at the Left Orbit — with the Right Super Cue still lit from the previous step, both Super Cues are now lit simultaneously.

steps.action: Shoot the lit Right Super Cue
steps.detail: Scores and sinks the next ball; immediately follow with the Left Orbit — don't touch anything else in between.

steps.action: Immediately shoot the lit Left Super Cue
steps.detail: Making both Super Cues back-to-back, one right after the other, lights the Captive Ball for an Extra Ball.

goals.title: Super Cue Consecutive Chain
goals.summary: A lit Super Cue stays lit through drains and ball changes — keep re-hitting the same orbit uninterrupted for 60K, 120K, 180K... per consecutive make.
goals.reward: 60K on the 1st consecutive make, escalating per make (60K, 120K, 180K...)

steps.detail: Hit the Purple standup while it's flashing.
1st consecutive make = 60K.

steps.action: Shoot it again without hitting anything else
steps.detail: 2nd consecutive make = 120K, and so on — any other switch resets the streak.

goals.title: Ball-O-Rama (2-Ball Multiball)
goals.summary: Lock one ball in the Center Pockets, then cash it in at the 8-Ball Saucer to start a 2x-scoring 2-ball multiball with a climbing jackpot.
goals.reward: 2-ball multiball, 2x scoring; jackpot starts 100K and climbs 10K/sec, never resets

steps.detail: Feed the Center Pockets until one ball settles in a lit side saucer — this automatically lights the 8-Ball Saucer for Ball-O-Rama.
Shoot the lit 8-Ball Saucer; the locked ball and the ball in play both eject. All scoring is now 2x.
Jackpot starts at 100K and climbs 10K/second while targets are being hit; it does not reset after being collected, so keep re-lighting and cashing it here.

goals.title: Breakshot Frenzy (3-Ball Multiball)
goals.summary: Lock both side saucers, then capture a third ball in the center saucer to auto-start a 3x-scoring 3-ball multiball with an easy, resetting jackpot.
goals.reward: 3-ball multiball, 3x scoring; jackpot starts 200K (+~5K erratic climb), 2 easy jackpots before relight needed

steps.detail: Settle a ball into the lit left side saucer.
Settle a ball into the lit right side saucer — two locked.

steps.action: Capture the third ball in the center saucer
steps.detail: This triggers Breakshot Frenzy immediately — no separate start shot. All scoring is now 3x.
Starts at 200K, ticks up ~5K erratically; resets to 200K after each collection. Default 2 easy jackpots before you must relight by hitting any Center Pocket saucer again.

goals.title: Breakshot Frenzy — Double Jackpot
goals.summary: After collecting a Frenzy jackpot the post rises to block re-entry; sneak a second ball in immediately after for a Double Jackpot bonus.
goals.reward: A Double Jackpot on top of the base Frenzy jackpot

steps.detail: Requires Breakshot Frenzy already running (locks + center-saucer capture).

steps.action: Watch the post rise to reseal the entrance
steps.detail: Happens automatically right after the jackpot collect.

steps.action: Get a second ball into the entrance opto immediately
steps.detail: If it trips the opto before the post fully seats, it scores a Double Jackpot. Triple Jackpot is mechanically impossible — only one entry opto.

goals.title: Eight Ball
goals.summary: Sink all 7 assigned colors (solids or stripes, randomly assigned) via the rollover lanes and standup/drop targets, then finish at the 8-Ball Saucer for 100K.
goals.reward: 100K + lights Call Your Shot for a shot at instantly finishing the next game too

steps.action: Sink a color via the rollover lanes
steps.detail: Yellow/Blue/Red lanes each sink one of your 7 assigned balls.

steps.action: Sink a color at the Purple standup
steps.detail: When lit, scores a ball directly.

steps.action: Sink a color at the Orange standup
steps.detail: When lit, scores a ball directly.
Clears the bank so the Green standup lights.
Sinks another assigned ball.
Clears the bank so the Brown standup lights.
Sinks the last assigned ball.
All 7 colors sunk — finishing here scores 100K and lights Call Your Shot for a shot at instantly finishing the next game too.

goals.title: Nine Ball
goals.summary: Hit any of 5 designated shots 9 times total — Left Orbit, Captive Ball, Right Orbit, Green standup, Brown standup — for 200K, plus a bonus wheel at the Center Pockets entrance.
goals.reward: 200K + a Center Pockets bonus wheel (Points/Special/Extra Ball)

steps.detail: Sinks the next ball in sequence — one of 5 usable shots.
A strong internal-target hit sinks a ball too.
Another of the 5 usable shots.
Requires the Green drop bank already cleared.
Requires the Brown drop bank already cleared. 9 total hits across these 5 shots completes Nine Ball for 200K.

steps.action: Cross the Center Pockets entrance for the Nine Ball Bonus
steps.detail: You can only collect it once per game of Nine Ball. It alternates between Points and Extra Ball every seven seconds, but it freezes on Points if you hold the ball without hitting anything, so trapping up to wait for the Extra Ball never works. Special only joins the rotation during your second game of Nine Ball.

goals.title: Rotation
goals.summary: The long game: sink all 15 balls using the same 7 shot-groups as Eight Ball, effectively cycling through them twice, for a 500K completion award.
goals.reward: 500K completion award

steps.detail: Each lane sinks its numbered ball; cycle through Yellow/Blue/Red twice across the 15-ball set.
Each full clear plus standup hit sinks one Green-assigned ball per pass.
Same mechanic on the right side.
Passes through the saucer are part of the full 1-15 sweep.

steps.action: Use Center Pockets saucer hits to sink whatever ball is lowest
steps.detail: Any saucer hit auto-sinks the lowest unsunk ball — a fast way to grind through Rotation's 15-ball requirement. Completion pays 500K.

goals.title: Call Your Shot
goals.summary: Lit briefly at the Left Inlane (and whenever the 8-ball is lit), Call Your Shot lets you pick one of three shots at the 8-Ball Saucer and instantly finish the current game if you hit it clean.
goals.reward: Instantly finishes the current game for its full completion award (flat 1M if during Cutthroat Countdown)

steps.detail: Briefly lights Call Your Shot; it also stays available whenever the 8-ball is lit.

steps.action: Shoot the 8-Ball Saucer to collect it
steps.detail: Cycles the display through 3 choices — Center Pocket / Left Super Cue / Right Super Cue — use the flipper button to select.

steps.action: Hit your called shot within 1-2 seconds
steps.detail: No other switch can be touched first. A successful call instantly finishes the current game with the full completion award (or scores a flat 1M if this happens during Cutthroat Countdown).

goals.title: Bonus Multiplier (Rollover Lanes)
goals.summary: Hitting the Yellow/Blue/Red rollover-lane diamond inserts advances the end-of-ball bonus multiplier — reported as high as 13x in the wild.
goals.reward: Advances the end-of-ball bonus multiplier (reported as high as 13x)

steps.detail: Advances the bonus multiplier one step and auto-sinks the lowest unsunk Yellow-group ball.
Same effect — flipper buttons can also cycle which multiplier light is lit (operator-configurable).

Keep cycling all three opportunistically through the ball. The bonus pays out when the ball drains, but the 8-Ball Saucer is also lit for Collect Bonus once each ball, so you can bank it mid-ball once the multiplier is worth banking.

goals.title: Bank Shot Bonus Multiplier (Left Super Cue Stack)
goals.summary: Front-load Left Super Cue hits before cashing the Bank Shot — each one doubles a stacking Bank Shot Bonus, reported as high as 3.2M, then cash it all in on one big Bank Shot.
goals.reward: Base Bank Shot value + a stacked bonus starting at 50K and doubling per Super Cue (reported as high as 3.2M)

steps.detail: Hit the Orange standup while flashing.

steps.action: Shoot the Left Super Cue before collecting the Bank Shot
steps.detail: Adds a 50K Bank Shot Bonus.

steps.action: Repeat the Left Super Cue shot
steps.detail: Each additional make before cashing the Bank Shot doubles the pending bonus: 50K → 100K → 200K → 400K...
Collects the base Bank Shot value plus the entire stacked bonus in one shot.

goals.title: Cutthroat Countdown (Wizard Mode)
goals.summary: Complete 3 regular games (default) to reach the game's wizard mode: a 60-second countdown where the machine calls balls one at a time for 1M each, ending in a per-ball Super Jackpot.
goals.reward: 1M per called ball sunk (+10 sec each) + a Super Jackpot of 2M/ball at timer's end, scaling 2x then 3x on repeats

steps.detail: Sink all 7 assigned colors, then shoot the 8-Ball Saucer to complete the game (100K).
Hit the 5 usable shots (Left/Right Orbit, Captive Ball, Green/Brown standups) 9 times total to complete it (200K).
Cycle the same 7 shot-groups twice to sink all 15 balls (500K). Completing your 3rd game (operator-configurable) triggers Cutthroat Countdown.

steps.action: Sink called balls fast during the countdown
steps.detail: The game calls balls one at a time, ≤10 seconds each; hitting the right target sinks it, scores 1M, and adds 10 seconds. Drop-target balls only need all 3 drops, not the standup.
If at least one ball was sunk, the center saucer lights for 2M per ball sunk in the round when the timer expires. Repeat completions scale to 2x then 3x per-ball value.

goals.title: Perfect Cutthroat Countdown
goals.summary: Sink every called ball in a single Cutthroat Countdown round to trigger a special animation, auto-spot the entire next regular game as complete, and drop straight into another Cutthroat Countdown.
goals.reward: Maxes the Super Jackpot + perfect-game animation + next game auto-spotted complete + straight into another Cutthroat Countdown

steps.action: Enter Cutthroat Countdown with a plan
steps.detail: Ideally with Breakshot Frenzy's 3x still running so each called-ball hit is worth up to 9M.

steps.action: Clear the first full pass of called balls
steps.detail: Hit whichever shot corresponds to each called ball in order, banking the +10 seconds each time.

steps.action: Clear the second pass (missed balls, random order)
steps.detail: Eight Ball variant always calls the 8-ball last.
Sinking every ball in the round maxes the Super Jackpot, triggers the perfect-game animation, spots the next game complete, and throws you straight into another Cutthroat Countdown.

goals.title: Beginner's First 30 Seconds
goals.summary: A low-risk opening sequence: safe skill shot, a few free loop reps, then easy standups and the forgiving captive ball before you ever aim at the risky center toy.
goals.reward: 100K skill shot + free Bank Shot loop points + a free Nine Ball spot + Extra Ball progress, all low drain risk

steps.detail: Guaranteed 100K + a sunk ball, virtually no drain risk.

steps.action: Catch it on the upper-right flipper
steps.detail: Sets up the Bank Shot loop.

steps.action: Repeat the Bank Shot catch-and-reshoot loop 2-4 times
steps.detail: Free points and free mode progress — bail before your catch timing gets shaky.

steps.action: Take the Left Orbit when it's open
steps.detail: Auto-spots a 9-ball toward Nine Ball with zero precision beyond hitting the orbit.
A forgiving, high-percentage shot that also builds Extra Ball progress (~4 hits).

steps.action: Feed Center Pockets only off a controlled, trapped shot
steps.detail: Don't force it off a bounce — fast ricochets here are the game's biggest drain hazard.

goals.title: Best Opener: Ride the Bank Shot, Then Bail
goals.summary: The competitive-player opener: treat the Bank Shot catch loop as a meter you deliberately cash out of once the value gets big, rather than a combo you run to failure.
goals.reward: Escalating Bank Shot value banked before it resets — community high 8.5M on a single shot

steps.action: Light-plunge into the Bank Shot line
steps.detail: Starts the loop with zero drain exposure — the ball is flipper-controlled the whole time.
Each successful lap sinks another ball and the Bank Shot value climbs (100K → 200K → ... reported 1M+ by lap 8-10).
A long unbroken run has been seen to reach 8.5M on a single Bank Shot.
The instant a catch feels shaky, or once you've banked a big number, send the ball down to the main flippers instead of risking a bad bounce that resets the value to base.

goals.title: Macro Strategy: Stack Frenzy Under Cutthroat Countdown
goals.summary: The top-end scoring line: get Breakshot Frenzy's 3x multiplier running, then time it to overlap with Cutthroat Countdown's called-ball scoring and Super Jackpot.
goals.reward: Up to 9M per called ball during Cutthroat Countdown (1M x Frenzy's 3x) while 3x is still running

steps.detail: Build toward Breakshot Frenzy rather than cashing Ball-O-Rama early.

steps.action: Capture the third ball to start Breakshot Frenzy
steps.detail: All scoring is now 3x for the duration.

steps.action: Push game completions toward Cutthroat Countdown while Frenzy is live
steps.detail: Complete whichever regular game is closest (Eight Ball/Nine Ball/Rotation) to trigger the wizard round.

steps.action: Sink called balls and take the Super Jackpot while 3x is still active
steps.detail: Per-ball Cutthroat scoring (1M) gets tripled by the still-running Frenzy multiplier for up to 9M per ball — but the Super Jackpot (2M/ball) is not multiplied by Frenzy, so time your called-ball hits, not the Super Jackpot collect, to land while 3x is active.

goals.title: Captive Ball Extra Ball
goals.summary: The captive ball only counts toward the extra ball when you hit it hard enough to reach its internal target — soft hits just score the little rollover value. Four solid hits (factory default) lights the extra ball.
goals.reward: Extra Ball after the required number of hard captive-ball hits (4 by default)

steps.action: Trap on the left flipper first
steps.detail: The captive ball wants a firm, square hit; take it from a dead stop rather than off a bounce.

steps.action: Hit it hard enough to reach the internal target
steps.detail: A strong hit registers the 30K target plus the rollover and counts one step toward the extra ball; a weak hit only scores 3K and counts for nothing.

steps.action: Repeat until the extra ball lights
steps.detail: Default is four qualifying hits, so keep coming back to it whenever you have a clean trap — it is one of the safest shots on the playfield.
Once the captive ball is lit for Extra Ball, one more hit banks it.

goals.title: Arm the Left Outlane Kickback
goals.summary: The left outlane has a kicker coil that saves the ball, and it re-lights whenever you knock down either three-target drop bank in sequential order. Cheap insurance worth taking early on every ball.
goals.reward: Lights the left-outlane kickback (a saved ball)

steps.action: Knock the Green bank down in sequence
steps.detail: Taking the three targets in order, not at random, is what arms the kicker; the bank clear also lights the Green standup for mode progress.

steps.action: Or work the Brown bank the same way
steps.detail: The right-side bank arms the kickback identically, and is the easier of the two off the upper-right flipper.

steps.action: Confirm the kicker light is on
steps.detail: With it lit, a left-outlane ball gets fired back into play instead of draining — re-arm it after every save.

achievements.title: Moose Tax

achievements.title: Cue Pair

achievements.title: Sank the Eight

achievements.title: Nine Down

drills.title: Light Plunge, Then Bank
drills.text: Plunge just softly enough that the ball drops onto the upper-right flipper instead of reaching the top lanes. Trap it there before you do anything else, then fire the lit Bank Shot for points and a sunk ball with almost no drain exposure.

drills.title: Catch, Shoot, Catch
drills.text: Shoot the Bank Shot, catch the return on the upper-right flipper, and go again without ever letting the ball leave that corner. This mini flipper traps cleanly, which is unusual, and the escalating value dies the moment a catch goes wrong, so bail down to the main flippers as soon as one feels shaky.

drills.title: Bank Shot Into The Orbit
drills.text: Land the Bank Shot and put the very next shot around the right orbit. Anything in between breaks it, so the orbit has to already be the plan when the Bank Shot goes in.

drills.title: Hit The Moose Hard
drills.text: Trap on the left flipper and hit the captive ball square and firm. A weak hit only trips the little rollover and counts for nothing toward the extra ball, so this drill is about power from a dead stop rather than aim.

drills.title: Both Cues, Back To Back
drills.text: Hit the flashing Purple standup and the flashing Orange standup so both Super Cues are lit at once, then take the right orbit and the left orbit one straight after the other. Nothing else can be touched in between, and the reward is an extra ball at the captive ball.

drills.title: Drops In Order
drills.text: Knock the Green or Brown bank down in sequence rather than in whatever order the ball offers. Taking the three in order is what arms the left-outlane kicker, and the Brown bank is the easier of the two to work from the upper-right flipper.

actionButton.how: Breakshot is a 1996 game with a plain manual plunger and two flipper buttons — nothing else on the cabinet does anything in play. Your flipper buttons do double duty off the playfield, though: they pick which shot you are calling on Call Your Shot, and holding one in mid-game brings up the info screens.

howItPlays.objective: Breakshot turns a game of pool into pinball: you rack and sink numbered balls to finish Eight Ball, Nine Ball and Rotation. Run enough pool games to reach Cutthroat Countdown, the timed wizard round where the table calls your shots one at a time.
loop: Sink your assigned balls with the top rollover lanes, the color drop banks and standups, the orbits and the captive ball to complete each pool game.
Soft-plunge onto the third flipper to light the Bank Shot, then catch and re-fire it from that corner for a value that climbs every lap.
Lock a ball in the Center Pockets for the 2x Ball-O-Rama, or trap both side saucers and settle a third in the center for the 3x Breakshot Frenzy.
Light the colored Super Cues off the Purple and Orange standups, then combo them into the orbits for big points and an extra ball.
Complete three pool games to trigger Cutthroat Countdown, then race the called balls before the timer expires.

lights.name: The Bank Shot
lights.lit: A soft plunge settles the ball on that third flipper up in the corner and turns the Bank Shot lane green; lit, it is the biggest repeatable earner on the table, and it holds its light only while you keep the ball trapped in that corner.
lights.flashing: The green light times out the moment the ball leaves the corner or a catch goes wrong, dropping the escalating value back to its base.
lights.then: Trap on the upper-right flipper, fire the Bank Shot, catch the rebound and go again -- each straight make scores more, past a million a lap on a long run, and sinks a ball in the active pool game. Bail to the main flippers the instant a catch feels shaky, and follow a Bank Shot into the right orbit for the Capcombo.

lights.name: The Super Cues
lights.lit: The flashing Purple standup wakes the Right Super Cue on the right orbit, and the flashing Orange standup wakes the Left Super Cue on the left orbit; once a Super Cue is lit it holds through every drain and ball hand-off until you finally shoot it.
lights.flashing: The Purple and Orange standups flash when each is ready to light its Super Cue.
lights.then: Re-shoot the same lit orbit with nothing in between for an escalating chain, or light both cues and shoot them back to back to arm the captive ball for an extra ball. Stacking Left Super Cue hits before you cash the Bank Shot doubles a pending bonus each time, into the millions.

lights.name: Top Rollover Lanes
lights.lit: One of the three top lanes -- Yellow, Blue, Red -- is lit; rolling the lit one advances your end-of-ball bonus multiplier a step and sinks the lowest ball you still owe in that lane's group.

control.effect: shift which of the three top lanes is lit sideways so you can line the lit one up with the lane the ball is dropping into
control.when: the ball is coming down through the top, where the operator has enabled flipper lane-change

lights.then: Slide the lit lane under the ball to bank a free multiplier step on every trip through the top, reported as high as thirteen times. The bonus pays at drain, but the 8-Ball Saucer also lights once a ball for Collect Bonus, so you can cash a big one mid-ball.

lights.name: Color Banks
lights.lit: Each three-target drop bank hides a color standup behind it; clear the whole bank and its standup lights to sink one assigned ball, and taking a bank down in sequential order also arms the left-outlane kickback.
lights.flashing: A color standup flashes once its three drops are all down.
lights.then: Work the banks to sink your Green and Brown pool balls and to keep the left outlane armed as cheap insurance -- re-arm it after every save. Of the two banks the Brown one is the kinder shot from the upper-right flipper.

lights.name: Center Pockets
lights.lit: A lit side saucer accepts a lock; one locked ball arms Ball-O-Rama over at the 8-Ball Saucer, while trapping both side saucers and then settling a third in the center saucer starts Breakshot Frenzy on the spot.
lights.then: Take Ball-O-Rama for 2x and a climbing jackpot, or hold out for Breakshot Frenzy and its 3x. Drive two balls off the raised center post into both side saucers on one hit for the namesake 250K combo. A fast ricochet out of this toy is the worst drain risk on the playfield, so feed it only off a controlled ball.

lights.name: 8-Ball Saucer
lights.lit: This one saucer carries the most jobs on the playfield: it sinks the 8-ball to finish Eight Ball, starts and re-jackpots Ball-O-Rama, banks Collect Bonus, and lights Call Your Shot -- briefly off the left inlane, and any time the 8-ball is lit.

control.effect: cycle the Call Your Shot display among its three named targets -- the center pocket or one of the Super Cues -- so you pick which one to make
control.when: Call Your Shot is lit at the saucer

lights.then: Clear your assigned colors and shoot here to complete Eight Ball, then use Call Your Shot to name a shot and make it within a second or two to finish the whole game at once. Rolling the left inlane is what briefly lights that pick.

lights.name: Captive Ball (The Moose)
lights.lit: The captive ball only ticks toward its extra ball on a hit firm enough to strike the target buried inside it; a soft nudge just trips the little rollover for a few thousand and counts for nothing.
lights.then: Trap on the left flipper and hit it firm and square -- four solid hits by default light it for an extra ball, and one more collects. It is among the safest, highest-percentage shots you have, and it doubles as a Nine Ball shot.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Tapping either flipper button shifts which of the three top rollover lanes -- Yellow, Blue, Red -- is lit, where the operator has enabled it. Slide the lit lane under the ball as it drops through the top, and rolling it steps your end-of-ball bonus multiplier a notch, reported as high as thirteen times, while sinking that lane's numbered ball.

scoring.text: Light-plunge for the Bank Shot skill shot -- a guaranteed hundred thousand plus a sunk ball at essentially zero drain exposure -- then ride the catch-and-reshoot loop a few laps and bail before your timing gets shaky. Take the left orbit and the forgiving captive ball for free pool progress.

Light the colored Super Cues and chain them for an extra ball, arm the left-outlane kickback off a drop bank, and lock the Center Pockets for a multiball. Ball-O-Rama runs at 2x and Breakshot Frenzy at 3x, so favor Frenzy whenever you can build to it.

Complete three pool games to trigger Cutthroat Countdown, where the table calls balls one at a time for a million each and pays a per-ball Super Jackpot when the clock expires. Time it to overlap Breakshot Frenzy's 3x so each called ball is worth up to nine million, and sink every one for the maxed, repeating Perfect Countdown.
